title: Akira
wikitext:
Dutch/Polish player that started playing QW in 1997, and had his most active peak from 2002 to approx. 2006 (mostly playing with Dutch players [[Murdoc]], [[Dragon]], [[Purity]], [[Optimizer]], [[Oase]], [[Amen]] and the likes). Was most known for being an avid FFA player, and for his solid E1M2 4on4 plays. 

After a long hiatus, started playing more regularly again in 2025 by participating in [[QWSL DIV2]].

== Trivia ==

Has shared parts of his QuakeWorld experiences in academia and art. For example (with links to external websites):

* in the old Theatrum Anatomicum in the Waag in Amsterdam, [https://www.lost.nl/en/contributors/marek-van-de-watering with a presentation on skins in QuakeWorld] (Amsterdam, The Netherlands, 2018, see image below)

* as part of a community art program in Amsterdam, teaching children with an immigrant background the basics of QuakeWorld (Amsterdam, The Netherlands, 2015, see image below)

* in the published paper [https://www.researchgate.net/publication/221024407_Online_Gaming_Communities_A_Practical_Shortlist "Online Gaming Communities: A Practical Shortlist"], which was presented at and published in the proceedings of GAMEON '2008 (Valencia, Spain, 2008)
